# @aponiajs/metrics

> Zero-dependency Prometheus metrics exposition, HTTP request histograms, and runtime gauges for an AponiaJS application.

## What this package exports

- `MetricsModule.forRoot(options?)` and `MetricsModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `MetricsService`: `counter()`, `gauge()`, `histogram()`, `render()`, `reset()`
- `MODULE_OPTIONS_TOKEN`, `METRICS_OPTIONS`, `PROMETHEUS_CONTENT_TYPE`, `DEFAULT_HTTP_BUCKETS`
